about_the_game:
About This Game

This game combines the gameplay of text adventure and card battles. You will play as an office worker who travels to another world, selecting cards to build your own deck. Random choice events provide you with various effects. Will you save everything, destroy everything, or do nothing at all?

Gameplay: Choices and Card Battles!

The world has a complete timeline: you will encounter various random events and major events that are bound to happen at certain moments. Every choice you make may alter the situation—saving a girl lost in madness, letting an enemy security robot go, or seeking out and challenging the supreme mystery of this world... Since you can start over anyway, do as you wish.

Build Your Own Deck: Choose and Delete Cards Prudently! 

During your adventure, you will have the chance to discover over a hundred different cards. Decide whether to add them to your deck, and through combinations and synergies, make your deck achieve the ultimate power of "1+1>2," defeating all enemies and completing your adventure!

The game currently includes the following content:

Over 500 usable cards.

More than 50 different NPCs.

Over 10 completely distinct Boss battles.

More than 100 events that may help you or get you into deep trouble.

short_description: While playing a new game on Steam, you unexpectedly traverse to another world. suddenly embark on an adventure in this otherworld, making choices again and again. In end, will you decide to save everything in the next loop, destroy it all, or do nothing at all? After all, you can restart infinitely!
